# edgeos_system_task_scheduler_task (Resource)

A scheduled task (`system task-scheduler task <name>`), a cron job that runs an executable on the router. Set exactly one of `interval` and `crontab_spec`.

The provider does not upload the executable; put it in `/config/scripts/` (which survives firmware upgrades) some other way. Destroying the resource deletes the task, not the executable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Update dynamic DNS every five minutes.
resource "edgeos_system_task_scheduler_task" "ddns" {
  name       = "asus-ddns"
  interval   = "5m"
  executable = "/config/scripts/asus-ddns.sh"
}

# Back up the config every night at 03:30.
resource "edgeos_system_task_scheduler_task" "backup" {
  name         = "backup"
  crontab_spec = "30 3 * * *"
  executable   = "/config/scripts/backup.sh"
  arguments    = "--keep 7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `executable` (String) Absolute path of the program to run (`executable path`), such as `/config/scripts/backup.sh`.
- `name` (String) Task name: letters, digits, `-` and `_`, up to 64 characters. Changing it creates a new task.

### Optional

- `arguments` (String) Arguments passed to the executable (`executable arguments`), as one string. EdgeOS values cannot contain double quotes.
- `crontab_spec` (String) Cron schedule (`crontab-spec`): five fields such as `30 3 * * *`, or a shortcut such as `@daily`.
- `interval` (String) How often the task runs: a number followed by `m` (minutes, the default unit), `h` or `d`, such as `5m`, `1h` or `1d`. Minutes must be below 60, hours below 24 and days below 32; use `1h` rather than `60m`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The task name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_system_task_scheduler_task.ddns
  id = "asus-ddns"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_system_task_scheduler_task.ddns 'asus-ddns'
```
